documents.title: Minibox Architecture Reference
documents.summary: 10-crate Rust 2024 workspace (v0.24.0). Hexagonal architecture with domain traits as ports in minibox-core, adapters in minibox/macbox/winbox. 5 wired adapter suites (native, gke, colima, smolvm, krun). 26 request / 24 response protocol variants over JSON-newline Unix socket.

documents.title: Crate Inventory
documents.summary: ~48k+ LOC across 159+ source files. 10 crates: minibox-core (12.6k), minibox (21.5k), miniboxd (1.6k), macbox (3.6k), mbx (3.2k), xtask (5k), minibox-macros (280), winbox (280), minibox-crux-plugin, minibox-testsuite.

documents.title: Feature Matrix
documents.summary: native: full features (namespaces, cgroups, overlay, bridge, exec, pause). gke: unprivileged pods (proot, copy FS). colima: Lima VM delegation. smolvm: default, subsecond VMs. krun: libkrun micro-VMs, fallback. winbox: stub.

documents.title: Security Invariants
documents.summary: 12 security invariants with regression tests: Zip Slip, device node rejection, absolute symlink rewrite, setuid stripping, FD-leak prevention, execve (not execvp), SO_PEERCRED auth, tar root skip, FIFO non-crash, request size limit (1MB), image pull limits (10MiB/10GiB/50GiB), execution manifest integrity.

documents.title: State Persistence Model
documents.summary: DaemonState behind Arc<RwLock>. Atomic JSON write (rename) after every mutation. State machine: Created->Running->Stopped/Failed, Running->Paused->Running, pid-dead->Orphaned. Startup reconciliation adjusts stale records. StateRepository trait for DI.

documents.title: Gotchas and Non-Obvious Patterns
documents.summary: Testing: unsafe set_var in Rust 2024, proptest async workarounds, subprocess test pattern. Protocol: HandlerDependencies 5 construction sites, handle_run 5-site param chain, serde(default) for compat. Container init: pipe fd management across clone(), pivot_root requires MS_PRIVATE, close_range fast path.

documents.title: Minibox Roadmap
documents.summary: P0: handler coverage >=80%, auth policy gate. P1: Windows phase 2. P2: networking hardening, exec cross-platform, Dockerfile parser, push/commit hardening. P3: OTEL tracing, metrics. Dogfood: MCP server for Claude, sandboxed AI code exec, CI agent.

documents.title: Protocol Source
documents.summary: DaemonRequest (26 variants) and DaemonResponse (24 variants). JSON-over-newline on Unix socket. Run request carries slashcrux Priority/Urgency/ExecutionContext. RunPipeline for multi-step agentic workflows.

documents.title: Domain Layer
documents.summary: Hexagonal ports (traits). Re-exports slashcrux vocabulary types. Helper: meets_min_priority(), execution_context_to_env(). Submodules: execution_manifest, execution_policy, extensions, networking.
